item.title: 'Secret Lives of Mormon Wives' star Whitney Leavitt extends Broadway run after massive ticket sales boost
item.description: Whitney Leavitt of "Secret Lives of Mormon Wives" fame has extended her run in "Chicago the Musical" on Broadway due to high demand.

item.title: 'My life is completely destroyed': Tenant hospitalized from The Hillcrest apartment fire speaks out
item.description: After a fire torched an apartment in the Avenues, ABC4 documented the aftermath of the fire in an exclusive walk-through with the victim and even spoke with the property manager face-to-face.

item.title: Accumulating snow wraps up Wednesday evening with more light snow arriving Thursday night
item.description: It's been a windy, snowy day across the Beehive state. Many areas across southern Utah saw numerous snow squall warnings issued for heavy snow and reduced visibility. The cold front arrived across northern Utah during the morning hours, leading to waves of moderate to heavy snow.

item.title: Winter weather causes hundreds of flight delays and cancellations at SLC airport
item.description: In the middle of heavy snow impacting the Wasatch Front, hundreds of flights at the Salt Lake City International Airport have been delayed, and dozens have been cancelled.

item.title: Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints Conference Center to close for nearly a year
item.description: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints announced that they will be closing their Conference Center until March 2027, except for major events.

item.title: Provo man caught trying to sell Pokémon cards he stole during event, documents say
item.description: A Provo man was allegedly caught trying to sell Pokémon and "One Piece" trading cards he stole during an event in Salt Lake.

item.title: Winter storm downs tree in Center Wells neighborhood of SLC
item.description: The winter storm has taken out a tree in the Center Wells neighborhood, but despite that, two neighbors are really excited about the snow.

item.title: Snow squalls slam Southern Utah in season's most severe storm so far
item.description: Between heavy mountain snow, strong winds, and difficult travel conditions, Southern Utah bore the brunt of this season's biggest storm yet.

item.title: Executive Appropriations Committee votes to return $12 million to Utah State University
item.description: Utah's executive appropriations committee voted unanimously to give back the millions in state funding lawmakers pulled from Utah State University (USU) last year.

item.title: Utah's national park nonprofits honored for work keeping parks open during 2025 shutdown
item.description: Utah's national park nonprofit partners were honored by the legislature and the governor today, recognizing the work they did to keep the national parks open during the 2025 government shutdown.
